{{Top|leg}}
The '''CM-9''' was a type of [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missile]] used by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] during the [[Black Fleet Crisis]].<ref name="TT">[[Tyrant's Test]]</ref>

CM-nines were tube-launched weapons carried by [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]]. The heavy cruiser [[Indomitable (Majestic-class)|''Indomitable'']] had at least three launch tubes on each flank of the hull, while the smaller but more attack-oriented [[Warrior-class gunship|''Warrior''-class gunship]] ''[[Vanguard (Warrior-class)|Vanguard]]'' had launchers at the bow and stern, and could launch at least eight CM-nines in a single rapid-fire attack.<ref name="TT" />

Although the various tubes launched their missiles in different directions, CM-nines were designed to steer around so that they could be used against targets in any direction, and the fact that they took separate routes to target, combined with their fast speed, also made it much more difficult for opponents to intercept them.<ref name="TT" />

However, the missiles could also be dangerous to the ships that carried them. Nearby hull damage could cause a launcher failure, which in turn could ignite an internal fire, as happened aboard the ''Vanguard''.<ref name="TT" />

The CM-9 designation was evidently part of the same series as the hardpoint-mounted [[CM-5 concussion missile|CM-5s]] used by the [[BTL-S8 K-wing assault starfighter]]. During the [[Battle of ILC-905]], the tough [[Deflector shield/Legends| deflectors]] of a single [[Yevetha|Yevethan]] [[Aramadia-class thrustship|thrustship]] absorbed hits from seven CM-nines and nine CM-fives before they collapsed.<ref name="TT" />

==Behind the scenes==
Within the text of the novel in which it appears, the name of this weapon is always written "CM-nine". The novel does not make it clear whether each individual "tube" or "launcher" has only one missile, or if they can be reloaded internally.<ref name="TT" />
